workload: facebook/opt-125m in fp16, batch size 1: a 104-token prompt (prefill), then 8 greedy decode steps reusing the KV cache
settings: Recorded after one identical warm-up run, with torch.profiler collecting CPU ops, GPU kernels and GPU memory. Profiling adds overhead to every CPU-side op, so CPU times here are longer than in an unprofiled run.
source: Recorded with tools/profile_example.py and reduced with tools/trace_extract.py; the CPU lane shows only top-level PyTorch ops, not the ops nested inside them.
